changes: Ordinary recording uses the voiceChat audio-session mode, Bluetooth HFP support and system voice processing, with acoustic filtering retained if processing is unavailable.
A shared 20 ms acoustic detector filters low-frequency rumble and high-crossing-rate hiss, adapts to background energy and requires 120 ms of valid activity in a bounded confirmation window.
A bounded copied onset buffer retains approximately 280 ms of pre-roll; noise-only buffers are not forwarded to Apple Speech.
Recognition partials and finals require acoustic speech evidence before reaching the chat session.
Quiet but confirmed speech keeps the endpoint alive, independent of the old waveform-display threshold.
Recognition turn IDs and recording generation IDs reject stale callbacks; old finalization timeouts cannot complete a later recording.

covers: Synthetic silence, 55 Hz vibration and deterministic broadband noise at 8 / 16 / 44.1 / 48 kHz
Quiet speech-shaped harmonic signals over 256 / 1024 / 4096 sample taps
Copied onset preservation and per-turn evidence reset
Existing interruption, mute, finalization and persistence behavior

preview.computerUse: Device Hub tree was accessible, but capture was white; native simctl screenshot confirmed the app instead.

limits: These are acoustic gate and orchestration regression tests using generated signals, not a measured microphone false-positive rate.

Real-device acoustic validation with room noise, short/quiet utterances, speaker playback and Bluetooth remains pending; nearby background speech or music is not guaranteed to be distinguished from the user.
deployment: iOS code only; latest Debug build installed in simulator; no backend deployment or App Store release.
